AGENDA
  GLENDALE CHARTER REVIEW COMMITTEE
  MUNICIPAL SERVICES BUILDING
  633 E. Broadway, Room 105
  Glendale, CA 91206
This meeting will be broadcast live on Glendale TV2, viewable on Spectrum Cable, channel 21, and
AT&T U-verse, channel 99. Meetings are also streamed live in high definition (HD)
on YouTube.com/myglendale. Meetings are archived on the City Website for viewing anytime
at glendaleca.gov/agendas.
PLEASE TURN OFF CELLULAR PHONES WHILE INSIDE THE MEETING LOCATION.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities (ADA) of 1990, auxiliary hearing aids, sign
language translation, and Braille transcripts are available upon request. Assisted listening devices
are available same-day upon request. The City Clerk’s office should be notified 72 hours (three
business days) or as soon as practicable for requests regarding sign language translation and
Braille transcription services. All documents related to open session items on this agenda that are
received less than 72 hours prior to this meeting, and are public records, will be available for review
in the Office of the City Clerk, 613 E. Broadway, Room 110, Glendale, CA 91206.
Translation services are provided for meetings through the use of bilingual staff for speakers who
wish to utilize the service as available. Speakers should state their request by contracting the City
Clerk’s office at (818)548-2090, at least 72 hours prior to the scheduled meeting or as soon as
practicable. Please specify the language for which you require translation. The exclusive use of City
provide interpreters is not required and persons are welcome to use their own interpreter or speak
in their native language.
  JANUARY 16, 2025 AT 5:00 PM

1. ROLL CALL

2. BUSINESS AGENDA
  a. Report of Recording Secretary, re: Posting of Agenda
  The Agenda for the January 16, 2025 Charter Review Committee Meeting was posted on
  January 13, 2025, on the bulletin board outside City Hall.

3. ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
  Discussion is limited to items not a part of this agenda. Each speaker is allowed 3 minutes. The
  Committee may question or respond to the speaker but there will be no debate or decision.
  The Charter Review Committee Lead may refer the matter to staff for investigation and report.

4. APPROVAL OF MINUTES

5. BUSINESS/DISCUSSION ITEMS
   a. Selection of a Chair
  b. Review of Proposed Charter Language Regarding the Location of City Council Meetings
  c. Review of Proposed Charter Language Removing Obsolete Officer/Employee Positions
  d. Review of Proposed Charter Cleanup Language to Article VI, Section 12 Pertaining to
  Councilmembers Holding Other Offices During Term and 2 Years After Leaving Office
  e. Discussion of Subjects Pertaining to Council Districts, Expanded Council, Directly Elected
  Mayor and Role of Directly Elected Mayor
  f. Resolution to establish a 2025 meeting calendar
  g. Minutes of the Charter Review Committee Meeting of December 12, 2024

6. REPORTS - INFORMATION

7. FUTURE AGENDAS

8. ADJOURNMENT
